title: 有馬記念の後に・昂揚

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though Satono Diamond missed out on first place, she still has a thrilling race with Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd cheers the two of them on, and Kitasan Black answers their fervor by announcing her plan to run in the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon hearing this, Satono Diamond declares she'll also race in the Osaka Hai, and the crowd is thrilled at the prospect of a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After returning to her waiting room, Satono Diamond says Kitasan Black has already contributed to the Umamusume world by always getting the fans excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wonders what she ought to do as an illustrious runner, and explains that she wants to use Kitasan Black as an example to think about her own role.
